svg.text: Gsdmd → Tmem106a: RNA architecture and a predicted fold
Reference-reconstructed RNA and protein sequence; the candidate fold remains low confidence.
SOURCE Venezia et al., Nature (2026), doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10982-x Figs 1 / 3; candidate_examples.json; reference_orf_verification.json; structure manifest
METHOD / LIMIT Symbolic exon widths. Retained RNA exons do not imply translation throughout. Boltz2 fold is predicted, not experimental.
Blue: in-frame Gsdmd sequence. Red: novel out-of-frame
